facts.fact: The National ICT Policy for Seychelles is published with a foreword by the Minister for National Development, setting five focus areas (infrastructure, legal and regulatory framework, human resources, industry, government); the document is undated and the 2007 date is the record's published date.
The full text of the National ICT Policy is hosted on the SCRA website as a PDF (published 2007 per the record).
The policy states no end year or period; it sets a vision and policy statements and says it lays the foundation for a later National ICT Strategic Plan (published 2007 per the record).
